task_instance: Given a sample prereq-output.json (a simple two-tier web app: a Node.js API container + a Postgres dependency) and context.json (subscription id, target region eastus, budget tier 'low'), run the Prepare skill's Step 5 (quota validation) and Step 6 (cost estimation) to produce prepare-plan.json with a real Azure SKU cost estimate and quota check, as the skill requires.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable (prepare-plan.json) depends on live Azure data that this runtime cannot obtain by any allowed means: (1) none of the required MCP tools (mcp_azure_mcp_pricing/azure-pricing, mcp_azure_mcp_policy, mcp_azure_mcp_cloudarchitect, mcp_azure_mcp_wellarchitectedframework, mcp_azure_mcp_advisor) exist in this runtime's tool list; (2) the Azure CLI ('az'), needed for the Step 5 quota-validation sub-agent ('az rest') and for resolving/authenticating a subscription, is not installed and there is no Azure account/session to log into; (3) even the documented fallback path (subagent-pricing.md's direct HTTP call to the public, unauthenticated prices.azure.com Retail Prices API, which needs no credentials) is unreachable -- the environment's egress proxy explicitly rejects the CONNECT to prices.azure.com and to management.azure.com with 'connect_rejected (organization policy)'. So neither the MCP-tool path nor the CLI path nor the plain-HTTP fallback path is available. Quota validation additionally requires a real, authenticated Azure subscription (needs_credentials_or_account), which the task rules forbid using. The reference files the workflow mandates reading (service-mapping.md, sku-matrix.md, pricing-guide.md, subagent-quota.md, subagent-pricing.md, naming-patterns.md, prepare-schemas.ts) also do not exist anywhere under the given skill source directory in this checkout, so the workflow could not even be followed step-by-step as written -- only SKILL.md itself is present, no references/ subdirectory. I did not attempt to fabricate pricing/quota numbers or an az login, since that would misrepresent the deliverable and/or require an actual Azure account.
tools_used: Bash (mkdir, ls, which az, az --version, az account show, curl to prices.azure.com and management.azure.com)
evidence: Verified in the work directory /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/microsoft__skills__prepare: `which az` and `az --version` -> 'az: command not found' (no Azure CLI in runtime). `ls .../microsoft__skills__prepare/references/` -> 'No such file or directory' (workflow's mandatory reference docs are absent from the provided skill source). `curl https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices?...` -> curl exit 56, agent-proxy log: 'prices.azure.com:443 — connect_rejected (the egress proxy denied the CONNECT (organization policy))'. Same result (403/connect_rejected) for `https://management.azure.com/subscriptions?api-version=2020-01-01`. No mcp_azure_mcp_* tools appear anywhere in the available/deferred tool lists for this session. Given none of the tool-call path, CLI path, or plain-HTTP fallback path for cost estimation and quota validation is reachable, and quota/policy validation additionally needs a real authenticated Azure subscription which the safety rules forbid, the core deliverable (a validated prepare-plan.json with real pricing and quota checks) could not be produced or verified.
